title: Saru Lock Reboot Manga Ends on June 1
content: Serizawa launched the manga in Young King BULL in October 2018. Shōnengahōsha shipped the manga's ninth volume in March 2025. The original Saru Lock manga follows Yatarō "Saru" Sarumaru, an ordinary high school boy who daydreams about idols but otherwise has no luck with girls.

title: NUMBER 8, Ten Ishida's Salaryman Z Manga Ends
content: NUMBER 8 and Ten Ishida published the final chapter of their Salaryman Z manga on Wednesday. The manga centers on 40 year old salaryman Yūsaka Maeyamada, who sticks to his old fashioned ways despite the modern times, idolizing businessmen and industrialists of days past.

title: One of Anime’s Darkest Franchises Shares New Look at Series Return
content: When it comes to dark anime series, there are plenty for fans to choose from. Franchises like Berserk, Attack on Titan, Death Note , and Devilman all create bleak worlds that see their heroes having to make some horrifying decisions to survive.

title: Satoshi Miyakawa's Namae no Nai Byōki Manga Ends in 3 Chapters
content: The manga debuted in August 2024. Shogakukan published the manga's third compiled book volume on February 27. The manga tells the story of Miyakawa's older brother who has been a recluse for 30 years. The story won the grand prize in the magazine's Superior Document Comic Grand Prize this year.

title: Deaf Crocodile to Release Frankenstein, Legend of Terror Anime With New 4K Restoration
content: Deaf Crocodile will release the anime as one of 12 titles in a six-month subscription plan between July-December. This was the subscription's 10th announcement, and other previously announced titles have not been anime.
